caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning process of a Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis, labeled ‘epoch’, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels spaced by 1 unit. The y-axis, labeled ‘WER’, ranges from approximately 25 to 42.5, with tick intervals of 2.5 units; the units are expressed as percentages. The ‘small AdaLoRA_int4’ line is represented by a solid black line, initiating at approximately 38.5 and decreasing to approximately 26.5 over the course of the 6 epochs. The ‘small AdaLoRA_int8’ line is a dashed orange line, beginning at approximately 41.5 and declining to approximately 27.5 during the same period. The ‘small int8’ line is a solid orange line that starts at approximately 30.5 and decreases to approximately 26 over the 6 epochs, and finally, the ‘small int4’ line is a dashed orange line that begins at approximately 32 and falls to approximately 29.5 during the 6 epochs.
